metadata.name: flatslab
metadata.description: FlatSlab pricing program for the INF (Sanctum Infinity) LST pool. Stores per-mint input/output fees (in nanos, denominator 1_000_000_000) in a single sorted slab PDA and prices swaps via binary search. NOTE: This is a native (non-Anchor) program. Instruction discriminators are a SINGLE leading byte (u8), not the 8-byte Anchor discriminator. The values in each instruction's `discriminator` array below are that single byte. Account data has no discriminator/header beyond the fields shown.

instructions.name: priceExactIn
docs: Given an input LST amount and its SOL value, returns the output SOL value.
Binary-searches the slab for the input and output mint entries, sums
inp.inputFeeNanos + out.outputFeeNanos, and applies it to the given SOL value.
Returns u64 (output SOL value) via Solana return data (little-endian).

instructions.name: priceExactOut
docs: Given an output LST amount and its SOL value, returns the input SOL value.
Binary-searches the slab for the input and output mint entries, sums
inp.inputFeeNanos + out.outputFeeNanos, and back-solves the input SOL value
assuming the fee was imposed on the input's resulting SOL value.
Returns u64 (input SOL value) via Solana return data (little-endian).

instructions.name: priceLpTokensToMint
docs: DEPRECATED in the new pricing interface: treat the LP token (INF) as any other LST
and call priceExactIn with outputMint = INF instead.
Given an input LST amount and SOL value, returns the SOL value of LP tokens to mint.
Equivalent to priceExactIn(inputMint = mint, outputMint = INF).
Returns u64 via Solana return data (little-endian).

instructions.name: setLstFee
docs: Set the input/output fees (in nanos) for a mint. Adds a new sorted entry to the slab
(reallocating up) if the mint is absent, otherwise updates the existing entry.
Only the admin may call. Fees must be within [MIN_FEE_NANOS, MAX_FEE_NANOS].

accounts.name: Slab
docs: Singleton account at PDA ["slab"]. Holds the admin plus a packed, mint-sorted array
of fee entries. The array grows/shrinks via realloc as mints are added/removed.
The LP mint (INF) is always present, so entries length is always >= 1.
There is NO account discriminator/header; data is exactly admin (32 bytes) followed by
the packed entries. Each entry is 40 bytes: mint (32) + inpFeeNanos (i32 LE) + outFeeNanos (i32 LE).

fields.name: admin
docs: Authority that can set a new admin, set fees, and add/remove mints

fields.name: entries
docs: Packed slice of fee entries, sorted ascending by mint

types.name: SlabEntry
docs: A single packed fee entry (repr(C), align 1, size 40 bytes).
fee values are stored little-endian and constrained to [MIN_FEE_NANOS, MAX_FEE_NANOS].
Rate is feeNanos / 1_000_000_000.
